## reading
r1a/r1b compare sha256(blob at REV) against a digest read from ANOTHER blob at the same REV
(c1-measure.json). Both are authored in one commit, so the pair is self-consistent and greens.
The rule is self-consistency, not provenance: nothing binds c1-measure.json to the r41 run, to
producer digests, or to the counter that produced it. Contrast tabi's own frozen instrument for this
class at SKILL.md:2476 (check-measurement-binding.mjs): counter blob sha256 AT measuredRevision,
ancestry of the measured revision, and countedInputs drift -- i.e. the measure record itself is pinned
to an older revision. C2's r1 has no such anchor.
